strategy.title: Fulfil the twelve signed ADAS calibration work orders through ProCal Mobile ADAS
strategy.why: Twelve independent collision shops have signed written work orders at $350 per calibration (EVIDENCE, 2026-11-20 to 11-25). ProCal Mobile ADAS LLC has quoted $210 per calibration in writing, invoiced net 15 after the work, so no capital is advanced. Each job keeps $140; twelve keep $1,680 against the $1,500 target. Shops pay within 10 days of the work and ProCal is paid on day 15 after the work, so cash never goes negative and everything settles inside 30 days. No new buyers are needed, so the unanswered buyer-volume question does not bear on this plan.

facts.value: Sell Post-repair ADAS camera and radar calibration for independent collision shops (mobile subcontractor) to each buyer.
ProCal Mobile ADAS LLC (written quote: $210 per calibration, invoiced net 15 after the work) quoted to do the work.
Twelve independent collision shops signed written work orders at $350 per calibration (signed orders, 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-25).

reviews.reasons: Twelve written acceptances at $350 are on the card (12 agreements, WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE, AGREED) and the price fact is EVIDENCE: twelve independent shops signed work orders 2026-11-20..11-25, so price is what these buyers pay and no new buyers or conversion are assumed; the unanswered buyerVolume question is correctly irrelevant to a plan that only fulfils signed orders. Fulfilment performer is the recorded fulfiller: ProCal Mobile ADAS LLC, written quote $210 per calibration, invoiced net 15 after the work (EVIDENCE). Arithmetic recomputed: 12 x $350 = $4,200 collected; 12 x $210 = $2,520 cost; net kept $1,680 >= $1,500 target (contribution metric). Shops pay within 10 days of the work and ProCal is due 15 days after it, so each job's receipt precedes its supplier payment: no capital is advanced and cash never goes negative (exposure cap $0 holds). With work on day 5, receipts settle by day 15 and ProCal is paid day 20, inside 30 days. Even if the calibrations spread to day 15, shop receipts land by day 25 and ProCal by day 30, still inside the window. EXECUTABLE is right: every link rests on this offer's own records.
findings: ProCal's capacity to perform all twelve calibrations on day 5 is not stated; scheduling them across days 5-15 still settles inside 30 days, so it does not change the verdict, but the last calibration must be done by day 15 for its ProCal payment (net 15) to fall in the window.

Residual credit risk: if a shop pays late or not at all after ProCal has worked, the $210 supplier invoice is still owed; with $1,680 net vs $1,500 target the plan tolerates one non-paying shop ($1,680 - $350 + ... = net $1,330 if one shop never pays but ProCal is paid) - actually one default drops net to $1,330, below target, so collection on each order matters.
SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; they must be connected before day 1 (setup, not an evidential unknown).
